sections.name: Appetizers
items: Ceviche Tostada
Fresh Shrimp marinated in fresh lime juice served traditional Mazatlan style with fresh salsa and salsa blanca
Shrimp Cocktail
Shrimp cocktail served traditional Baja style with diced avocados, cucumbers, and fresh salsa, a signature dish!!
Nachos
Freshly cooked corn chips covered in melted Monterey Jack & Cheddar cheeses and fresh salsa
Nachos Especial
Freshly cooked corn chips covered in refried beans, melted cheeses, sour cream, and avocado and sour cream whipped together
Nachos Baja
A step above, same as Especial; add shredded beef, chicken, or both
Nachos Mexicana
Truly the ultimate Nacho’s; To Nachos Especial add, Carne Asada, sliced carrots and jalapenos, guacamole Mexicana and sour cream

sections.name: Marisco's (Seafood)
items: Camarones-Shrimp

Enjoy succulent Shrimp one of 6 ways, served with rice & beans, shredded lettuce, guacamole and flour tortillas. 1. Al Mojo De Ajo—Grilled in Garlic, Butter & Olive Oil 2. Diabla—Spicy! Shrimp sauteed in Garlic, Butter, Olive Oil, Tomatoes, Red 3. Ranchero-Sliced Bell Pepper, Onions,Tomatoes, Olive oil and garlic. 4. Fajitas—“The Classic” this dish needs no explanation. 5. Mole—Shrimp sautéed in our wonderful Mole sauce, spicy and sweet. 6. Mango—Muy Sabroso! Over Rice with fresh Avocado slices and Mango salsa
Shrimp Quesadilla
Choose from Mojo de Ajo, Diabla, Ranchero, or Mole sauces, finished with fresh guacamole
Fish Burrito Especial
Fresh Canadian Pollack sautéed in olive oil, salt, pepper and paprika. Wrapped in a 13” flour tortilla with rice, sliced avocados, salsa blanca fantastic!
Shrimp Enchiladas
Shrimp sautéed in Salsa Mexicana, butter, salt & pepper, wrapped in two corn tortillas with a little salsa blanca, topped with red and green cabbage and more salsa blanca Yummm!
Shrimp Burrito
Your choice of Mojo de Ajo, Diabla, Ranchero or Mole. Served with rice and sliced avocados inside a flour tortilla

sections.name: Baja's Favorites
items: Filet of Mahi Mahi, Al Mojo de Ajo
Fresh Mahi filet sautéed in olive oil, garlic, butter, seasoned just right! Served with rice and beans, sliced oranges and sliced avocados Delicioso! Also available Diabla or Ranchero
Shrimp Tacos
Like our fish tacos, the difference, succulent Shrimp, served with rice and beans
Shrimp Baja
Shrimp sautéed in light salsa Mexicana, olive oil and seasonings, served over rice with sliced avocados and a touch of salsa blanca!
Seafood Stuffed Burrito
Shrimp, crab, and fish sautéed in olive oil, butter, and garlic, with rice, sliced avocados, and salsa blanca
Seafood Stuffed Chile Relleno
Huge Poblano chile, stuffed with shrimp, crab, and fish with it’s own light sauce or Diabla or Ranchero, served with rice & beans
Shrimp Chipotle Style
Shrimp sautéed in in our fantastic chipotle salsa, served with rice, beans, guacamole and tortillas
Enchiladas, Rojo or Verde
Huge chicken enchiladas with our savory mild and creamy red or green salsa, served with rice and beans
Baja’s Ribs

At Baja’s we slow roast our ribs for at least 3 hours making sure they are juicy and oh so tender. We then serve them in our own barbecue sauce, diabla salsa with secret ingredients and a touch of molasses! If you like ribs these are a must try!! Served with rice and beans
Tortas

Tortas are the traditional Mexican sandwich, at Baja’s we serve them on a toasted hearth roll, in the traditional style. We add beans, lettuce, tomato, mayonnaise and sliced avocados. Your choice; Carne Asada, Carnitas or Pollo Asada! Fantastic !
Baja’s Burger
One half pound lean ground beef burger, served with Monterey Jack and and cheddar cheese, bacon, sliced avocado, lettuce and tomato, w/fries

sections.name: Desserts
items: Apple Cinnamon Chimichanga

Apples sautéed in butter, brown sugar, vanilla and cinnamon, wrapped in a flour tortilla. Deep fried, rolled in powdered sugar, served w/vanilla ice cream, butterscotch, whipped cream, topped w/walnuts. mmmmmm!!!
Banana Flautas
Bananas sautéed in Jamaican rum, vanilla and chocolate, wrapped in a flour tortilla, deep fried, rolled in powdered sugar, sliced in two, served w/vanilla ice cream and chocolate syrup…...wow!
Flan
Traditional Mexican custard with caramelized sugar, ours is the best you’ve ever tasted!
Deep Fried Ice Cream
Fried Vanilla ice cream w/chocolate sauce or butterscotch
Bunuelos
Crispy flour tortilla chips, made to order, dusted with sugar and cinnamon served warm with vanilla ice cream! Yummy
